messages.en:
{07 16 00}Wow, it's really hard to
complete the
{01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 17 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}Would you help me look?{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 04 00}No pressure!{01 00 00 05 00} I understand
if you're too busy!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Vau, on tõesti raske
täiendada
{01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 17 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}Kas sa aitaksid otsida?{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 04 00}Ilma surveta!{01 00 00 05 00} Ma mõistan,
kui sul on liiga kiire!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I need to complete the
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}
fossil really soon!
{07 06 00}I can't wait to break out
my magnifying glass and 
see all the little details!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma pean {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}
fossiili varsti
valmis saama!
{07 06 00}Ma ei jõua ära oodata, et
võtta välja luup ja 
näha kõiki pisidetaile!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}The complete{ff 00 00 02}
{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}fossil

{07 14 00}I hope I appreciate it more
because it's been so hard
to find!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}Täielik{ff 00 00 02}
{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}fossiil
